Author: @京悪者
Content:
I highly encourage you to make your own wicks. Candles are generally made of parafin wax which is not food safe and the wicks you can buy like that are coated in parafin wax as well. You can buy uncoated wicks and coat them in beeswax (which is food safe) or the fat of the candle you're making. To make sure they stay in the bottom, a bit of uv resin should suffice to hold it in place (epoxy resin is food safe as long as it's fully cured but even then be very careful with heat above 165 since that can pose a risk with the resin).
Other than that, this isn't a huge stretch :) persistent light sources were made out of animal fat since the dawn of fire lmao This is just the next step from there. The only reason candles weren't made from animal fat for very long is because they ran out too fast. Wax burns slower so once that was discovered, it became more efficient to make candles out of wax or a mix of wax and fat.
